issues.detail: The Vietnamese phrase 'đồng một thứ với' (is the same thing as) fails to capture the specific Greek meaning of 'καταισχυνει' (shames/disgraces) in relation to the preceding clause. More importantly, the Vietnamese translation of 'η προφητευουσα' as 'hoặc nói tiên tri' (or prophesying) changes the structure from a coordinated subject ('woman praying [and] prophesying') to an alternative choice ('praying or prophesying').
